text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин has been giving her all
in her
recent races, so we've come here
to buy her
something sweet as a reward.
However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Jiggly pudding, cake with whipped
cream...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I've been given the opportunity to eat
my
beloved sweets, yet my appetite
falters.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
While it's certainly welcome that I refrain
from
overeating... this just... comes as
such a shock.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
My guess is she's still feeling tired. I
should
probably reevaluate her race
schedule to ensure
she can perform at
her best going forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
